features.action: Created a fresh .6 project with the matching launcher, copied the Curious City r5 Source/Content into its generated folders, and ran --check-project.
features.expected: Fresh project keeps generated metadata, has no duplicate Source/Content nesting, and passes project validation.
features.actual: Project.json and generated Source/Content layout present; --check-project exit 0. Build logs retain the LNK1101 sandbox attempt and later successful elevated scaffold build.

features.action: Upgraded the real r5 final-city project into a new r6 folder, built with Game/build/x64/Release/Runtime/SDK/ProjectTools.ps1, then checked the copy.
features.expected: Original stays unchanged; new copy pins .6, retains custom house type and scene, builds against current SDK, and validates.
features.actual: --upgrade-project exit 0; new lock is .6; custom source/scene retained; current SDK build validated and activated; --check-project exit 0.

features.action: Ran a 130-frame project.input request on the migrated project after current SDK build, with CURIOUS_CITY_SAVE_ROOT inside the playtest directory.
features.expected: Save 400/1 house; after income add a second house; load restores 400/1; income continues.
features.actual: exit 0. Log: save 400/1, second build 300/2, load restored 400/1, later income reached 410/1. Save file is under private SaveGameHudFinal.

features.action: project.input clicks ground at (500,400), Build at (70,120), Save at (145,120), Build again, then Load at (250,120); advances 30 frames after load.
features.expected: Two purchases deduct 200; save; a third house is temporary; load restores two houses and saved balance.
features.actual: exit 0. Callbacks logged for ground placement, build, save, build, load. House count rises to 3 then returns to 2; SaveGame log restores balance 300 / houses 2.
features.visualStatus: runtime inputs and state observed; desktop game frame unverified

features.action: In the isolated upgraded project, localized Balance/Income/Homes, added a ground-click placement hint, named the three actions in Russian, and widened the panel/buttons; rebuilt and reran the economy and HUD save/load requests.
features.expected: A Russian-speaking player can see currency, per-second income, house count, placement instruction, and clear button actions without changing game architecture.
features.actual: Current SDK build activated; 130-frame cycle and HUD Save/Load cycle passed after the edit.

features.action: Current EngineCommandlets project.import imported Hero..v2.obj at 0.01, used the same source for reimport, and moved it to /Game/Models/Moved/.
features.expected: Legal doubled-dot filename is accepted; sidecar and all newly placed objects retain 0.01 through reimport and move.
features.actual: exit 0, accepted=true, no dialogs, sidecar scale 0.01; spawned/reimported/moved object scales all 0.01. 800x500 editor image shows three objects and Inspector Scale 0.010.
features.visualStatus: inspector/layout observed; hidden viewport is black

features.action: Current EngineCommandlets project.import imported MarketHouse.obj at scale 0.1.
features.expected: Sidecar records 0.1 and UseAsset places the model at uniform scale 0.1.
features.actual: exit 0, accepted=true, sidecar scale 0.1 and one new Engine.Model at scale 0.1; 1280x720 layout snapshot saved.

features.action: Custom six-frame render.point-shadows request with three point lights, crowd LODs at distances 12/20, and camera distances 6/14/24.
features.expected: At most two active shadow slots; zero-intensity lights own no slot; camera selects LOD0/1/2; returning to original frame is stable.
features.actual: exit 0; base slots [0,1,-1], zero-intensity first [-1,0,1], zero-intensity third [0,1,-1]; LOD levels [1,0,0], [0,1,0], [0,0,1] at 6/14/24; returned first-face hash equals baseline.
features.visualStatus: six D3D BMPs captured; slot/LOD/frame hashes observed

features.action: Rendered two intersecting translucent planes and self-cross geometry at four camera angles, then rendered a 640x360 frame.
features.expected: Color overlap changes with camera angle; materials remain visible through intersecting surfaces; resized render succeeds.
features.actual: Both commands exit 0; four orbit BMPs show red/blue translucent overlap from changed angles; resize output is 640x360 (691254-byte BMP). External HLSL produced a nonfatal dynamic-mount warning.
features.visualStatus: D3D images captured and inspected; no independent pixel oracle

features.action: Enabled and saved a WarmStone graph; selected preset 1, applied, undid, redid, then reverted.
features.expected: Graph edits apply and enter history; undo/redo switch graph/HLSL; revert returns to the saved baseline.
features.actual: exit 0; all seven steps accepted; graph/HLSL hashes change at preset/apply, undo returns the saved hash, redo restores the preset hash, revert leaves dirty=false and saved HLSL. nativePreviewWindow=true. Qt PNG renders graph; native D3D preview pane is black/not captured.
features.visualStatus: graph visible; preview pixels not verified

features.action: Custom render.point-shadows request with caster=skeletal, sceneLighting=true, Deferred, and animation times 0, 0.5, 1, 0 at a fixed camera/light.
features.expected: Animation changes shadow-map hashes at 0.5; t=1 and the final return match the t=0 pose; receiver probe responds to the moving shadow.
features.actual: exit 0 on RTX 4070 Laptop GPU. t=0, t=1, and return share all six face hashes. t=0.5 changes two face hashes; probe at the origin changes occlusion state.
features.visualStatus: four D3D frames captured; t=0 and t=0.5 images inspected

features.action: Custom Deferred render.transparency request with overlapping skeletal and crowd cross geometry; five frames at times 0, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 0; camera orbit/near/far positions; viewport 320x256 and 640x360; crowd LOD thresholds 160/80 pixels.
features.expected: Both animated transparent types render during camera motion; crowd LOD changes at distance; resizing succeeds; the same starting frame returns the same image hash.
features.actual: exit 0 on RTX 4070 Laptop GPU. lod levels change from [2,0,0] at the initial view to [0,2,2] at the far view. BMP sizes are 320x256/640x360 as requested; final time-0 return hash equals initial image hash.
features.visualStatus: five D3D frames captured; intersections and far LOD image inspected
